messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Under what circumstances is it required that guards on moving transmission parts be interlocking movable guards rather than fixed guards?

response.text: In quali circostanze è richiesto che i ripari delle parti di trasmissione in movimento siano ripari mobili con interblocco anziché ripari fissi?
